name: [x2 UPD2!] Ultra unFair
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Ultra Unfair! 🔥

🎲 Roll for powerful abilities, from common to incredibly rare. Every roll could unlock your next favorite power.

⬆️ Level up your abilities to make them stronger, unlock new potential, and create your own playstyle.

⚔️ Challenge other players in PvP, test your skills, and prove that you're the strongest.

Will you rely on luck, skill, or both? Jump in and see if you can survive the world of Ultra Unfair!
